name: Baked Mediterranean Tilapia
instructions: Defrost tilapia and preheat oven to 375 degrees
Peel and slice onions 1 / 4" thick , keeping the rings together
Transfer sliced onion with a pancake turner to a skillet
Saute onion in olive oil over medium heat , 2-3 minutes on each side , or until onions are translucent
In a 13"x9"x2" roasting pan , arrange half of the onion slices to cover the bottom
Place fish on top of onions
Sprinkle olives , garlic , basil and pepper over the fish
Top with remaining onion slices and sliced tomatoes
Place pan with fish in center of oven , uncovered , and bake for 12-15 minutes , or until fish is opaque
